description: Apple TV Aerial Screensaver for Mac

latest_release.name: v3.6.3
latest_release.body:
## What's new:
- Fix settings not working on anything but macOS Tahoe . Built with Xcode 16.4 until beta SDK is fixed.
- Contains fix for weather from previous version. If you still have issues with weather with this version please open an issue and post the log so I can have a look!

## Reseting your settings
If you have an issue/crash during startup, you can reset your settings with this command line : 
```
defaults delete ~/Library/Containers/com.apple.ScreenSaver.Engine.legacyScreenSaver/Data/Library/Preferences/com.glouel.Aerial.plist 
```
